'''2018 Worlds Day 3 Matt Wadden LS Combat Preparedness (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Matt Wadden]] at [[2018 World Championship]] (Day 3).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Matt Wadden]]
* '''Event:''' [[2018 World Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Careful Planning (V)|Endor-L-carefulplanning.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open Combat Preparedness (V) Wadden 2.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-world-championships/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210127123938/https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-world-championships/ Internet Archive]
